subject.title: ci: add unsigned iOS build workflow

question: Should OpenClaw core own a manually dispatched unsigned iOS `.xcarchive` workflow, or should this remain an external fork workflow?
rationale: The code defects are mechanically fixable, but accepting a new artifact-producing macOS workflow is a maintainer-owned automation and distribution decision.

options.title: Harden And Accept Core Workflow
options.body: Fix the workflow security issues, rerun proof, and treat the unsigned archive lane as maintainer-owned OpenClaw CI.

options.title: Keep It External
options.body: Leave the contributor's fork workflow as the supported experiment if OpenClaw should not publish unsigned archive artifacts from core CI.

options.title: Defer Until Install Path Is Settled
options.body: Wait for the separate local-install trust model before deciding whether the artifact-producing workflow belongs in core.

recommendation.title: Harden And Accept Core Workflow
recommendation.body: Fix the workflow security issues, rerun proof, and treat the unsigned archive lane as maintainer-owned OpenClaw CI.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iOS workflow and CI hardening history makes this the best available owner for the workflow acceptance choice.
